Bot review was quota-refused in comment6029732188; independent full-scope review/QA remains required. Native device rotation, OS large-font and screen-reader checks are unexecuted. Actual GitHub-page rendering uses the explicit waiver; genuine image pixels and provenance were verified.

Stable geometry for #30: `b21d3ba7370c08468b868385ce9df3d875eee799`. No transition or audio-lifecycle work is included. Draft/readiness and Project progression remain with the coordinator.
